purpose: Carry source-backed historical control-point correspondences into georeference authoring without granting political-boundary authority.
rules: sourceArtifactId must resolve to a retained or explicitly reference-only artifact record.
sourceRef must resolve to the historical anchor registry.
pixel and geo are correspondence evidence, not polygon vertices.
politicalExtentConfidence is never promoted by successful georeference.
Two-point calibration is provisional and requires independent anchor sanity validation.
Three-or-more inconsistent correspondences must fail closed.
No adapter output may set authorityStatus to canonical.
No adapter output may write MapBin or canonical political geometry.
